premises.text: Without rapid, accessible diagnostics to determine who is infected, diseases continue to spread and patients wait months for results
premises.evidence_span: Without rapid, accessible diagnostics to determine who is infected, diseases continue to spread

premises.text: Dipstick tests are portable but not sensitive enough for early detection, while PCR is sensitive but costly and not easily portable so results take days
premises.evidence_span: the dipstick test, similar to the pregnancy test, is portable. However, it's not sensitive enough to detect early case detection. And the PCR, although it's very sensitive, it is very costly

premises.text: FastChip is a field-ready vacuum-driven chip that needs zero external power or pumps and can be carried in a bag
premises.evidence_span: The chip requires zero power because everything is driven by vacuum

premises.text: Isothermal nucleic acid amplification on the chip has PCR-comparable sensitivity and yields quantitative pathogen concentration from fluorescing microwells within about one hour
premises.evidence_span: We are using isothermal nucleic acid amplification, which has comparable sensitivity with PCR tests, the industry standard

premises.text: A trackable app platform records GPS, patient info, and test results as a disease-tracking network for ministries of health
premises.evidence_span: We're building a trackable platform, an app that tracks GPS data, patient info, and test results

premises.text: Launch path starts as a research toolkit, then after sample prep integration and FDA clearance as a human diagnostic kit
premises.evidence_span: Initially, we plan to launch this as a research toolkit. Then, after integrating sample prep and clearing FDA approval, we'll market this as a human diagnostic kit

value.text: Patients get molecular diagnostic results within one hour in the field instead of waiting days or months
value.evidence_span: Results come out within one hour, so patients don't have to wait for days to get the results

secondary_value.text: Enable ministries of health to deploy resources in outbreak hotspots
secondary_value.evidence_span: We hope to enable ministries of health to optimally deploy the resources in the hotspots

causal_links.evidence_span: This is why Amfluidic solution is so much more affordable and low cost
Without rapid, accessible diagnostics to determine who is infected, diseases continue to spread
Results come out within one hour, so patients don't have to wait for days to get the results
So this becomes a powerful disease tracking network
